name: Amazon
summary:
Shoppers and marketplace sellers bookmark amazon.com, then look up the tab icon when a seller tool or a browser profile shows an empty favicon. The files below are the image bytes that host returned.

Checked 12 November 2026 against amazon.com. HTML came from https://www.amazon.com/ (HTTP 200). No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.amazon.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 15086 bytes. Directory sizes: 48×48, 32×32, 16×16.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

No brand colour could be derived. The page had no theme-color, mask-icon colour, or manifest theme_color, and a dominant pixel colour was not readable from the saved PNGs.

The only measured sizes are inside favicon.ico: 48×48, 32×32, 16×16.
